_description: Print the active sprint name at session start if a SPRINT.md exists in .claude/.
_test: echo '{}' | bash -c 'f=".claude/SPRINT.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then name=$(grep -m1 "^# Sprint:" "$f" | sed "s/^# Sprint: //"); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Sprint: $name\"}"; fi'

hooks.command: f=".claude/SPRINT.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then name=$(grep -m1 "^# Sprint:" "$f" | sed "s/^# Sprint: //"); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Active sprint: $name\"}"; fi 2>/dev/null || true
